verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés e a Arão:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.en: This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:
verses.pt: Este é o estatuto da lei que o Senhor ordenou, dizendo: Dize aos filhos de Israel que te tragam uma novilha vermelha sem defeito, que não tenha mancha, e sobre a qual não se tenha posto jugo:
verses.en_web: “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and which was never yoked.
verses.en_bbe: This is the rule of the law which the Lord has made, saying, Give orders to the children of Israel to give you a red cow without any mark on her, and on which the yoke has never been put:

verses.en: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:
verses.pt: Entregá-la-eis a Eleazar, o sacerdote; ele a tirará para fora do arraial, e a imolarão diante dele.
verses.en_web: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face.
verses.en_bbe: Give her to Eleazar the priest and let him take her outside the tent-circle and have her put to death before him.

verses.en: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
verses.pt: Eleazar, o sacerdote, tomará do sangue com o dedo, e dele espargirá para a frente da tenda da revelação sete vezes.
verses.en_web: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.
verses.en_bbe: Then let Eleazar the priest take some of her blood on his finger, shaking the blood seven times in the direction of the front of the Tent of meeting:

verses.en: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
verses.pt: Então à vista dele se queimará a novilha, tanto o couro e a carne, como o sangue e o excremento;
verses.en_web: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.
verses.en_bbe: And the cow is to be burned before him, her skin and her flesh and her blood and her waste are to be burned:

verses.en: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
verses.pt: e o sacerdote, tomando pau do cedro, hissopo e carmesim, os lançará no meio do fogo que queima a novilha.
verses.en_web: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.
verses.en_bbe: Then let the priest take cedar-wood and hyssop and red thread, and put them into the fire where the cow is burning.

verses.en: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: Então o sacerdote lavará as suas vestes e banhará o seu corpo em água; depois entrará no arraial; e o sacerdote será imundo até a tarde.
verses.en_web: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And the priest, after washing his clothing and bathing his body in water, may come back to the tent-circle, and will be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
verses.pt: Também o que a tiver queimado lavará as suas vestes e banhará o seu corpo em água, e sera imundo até a tarde.
verses.en_web: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.en_bbe: And he who does the burning is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.
verses.pt: E um homem limpo recolherá a cinza da novilha, e a depositará fora do arraial, num lugar limpo, e ficará ela guardada para a congregação dos filhos de Israel, para a água de purificação; é oferta pelo pecado.
verses.en_web: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.
verses.en_bbe: Then let a man who is clean take the dust of the burned cow and put it outside the tent-circle in a clean place, where it is to be kept for the children of Israel and used in making the water which takes away what is unclean: it is a sin-offering.

verses.en: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
verses.pt: E o que recolher a cinza da novilha lavará as suas vestes e será imundo até a tarde; isto será por estatuto perpétuo aos filhos de Israel e ao estrangeiro que peregrina entre eles.
verses.en_web: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.
verses.en_bbe: And he who takes up the dust of the burned cow is to have his clothing washed with water and be unclean till evening: this is to be a law for ever, for the children of Israel as well as for the man from another country who is living among them.

verses.en: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
verses.pt: Aquele que tocar o cadáver de algum homem, será imundo sete dias.
verses.en_web: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
verses.en_bbe: Anyone touching a dead body will be unclean for seven days:

verses.en: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
verses.pt: Ao terceiro dia o mesmo se purificará com aquela água, e ao sétimo dia se tornará limpo; mas, se ao terceiro dia não se purificar, não se tornará limpo ao sétimo dia.
verses.en_web: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
verses.en_bbe: On the third day and on the seventh day he is to make himself clean with the water, and so he will be clean: but if he does not do this on the third day and on the seventh day, he will not be clean.

verses.en: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
verses.pt: Todo aquele que tocar o cadáver de algum homem que tenha morrido, e não se purificar, contamina o tabernáculo do Senhor; e essa alma será extirpada de Israel; porque a água da purificação não foi espargida sobre ele, continua imundo; a sua imundícia está ainda sobre ele.
verses.en_web: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles Yahweh’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.
verses.en_bbe: Anyone touching the body of a dead man without making himself clean in this way, makes the House of the Lord unclean; and that man will be cut off from Israel: because the water was not put on him, he will be unclean; his unclean condition is unchanged.

verses.en: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.pt: Esta é a lei, quando um homem morrer numa tenda: todo aquele que entrar na tenda, e todo aquele que nela estiver, será imundo sete dias.
verses.en_web: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.en_bbe: This is the law when death comes to a man in his tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, will be unclean for seven days.

verses.en: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
verses.pt: Também, todo vaso aberto, sobre que não houver pano atado, será imundo.
verses.en_web: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.
verses.en_bbe: And every open vessel without a cover fixed on it will be unclean.

verses.en: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.pt: E todo aquele que no campo tocar alguém que tenha sido morto pela espada, ou outro cadáver, ou um osso de algum homem, ou uma sepultura, será imundo sete dias.
verses.en_web: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.en_bbe: And anyone touching one who has been put to death with the sword in the open country, or the body of one who has come to his end by a natural death, or a man's bone, or the resting-place of a dead body, will be unclean for seven days.

verses.en: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
verses.pt: Para o imundo, pois, tomarão da cinza da queima da oferta pelo pecado, e sobre ela deitarão água viva num vaso;
verses.en_web: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured into a vessel.
verses.en_bbe: And for the unclean, they are to take the dust of the burning of the sin-offering, and put flowing water on it in a vessel:

verses.en: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
verses.pt: e um homem limpo tomará hissopo, e o molhará na água, e a espargirá sobre a tenda, sobre todos os objetos e sobre as pessoas que ali estiverem, como também sobre aquele que tiver tocado o osso, ou o que foi morto, ou o que faleceu, ou a sepultura.
verses.en_web: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.
verses.en_bbe: And a clean person is to take hyssop and put it in the water, shaking it over the tent, and all the vessels, and the people who were there, and over him by whom the bone, or the body of one who has been put to death with the sword, or the body of one who has come to his end by a natural death, or the resting-place was touched.

verses.en: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
verses.pt: Também o limpo, ao terceiro dia e ao sétimo dia, a espargirá sobre o imundo, e ao sétimo dia o purificará; e o que era imundo lavará as suas vestes, e se banhará em água, e à tarde será limpo.
verses.en_web: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.
verses.en_bbe: Let the clean person do this to the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he is to make him clean; and after washing his clothing and bathing himself in water, he will be clean in the evening.

verses.en: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
verses.pt: Mas o que estiver imundo e não se purificar, esse será extirpado do meio da assembléia, porquanto contaminou o santuário do Senhor; a água de purificação não foi espargida sobre ele; é imundo.
verses.en_web: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of Yahweh. The water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him. He is unclean.
verses.en_bbe: But the man who, being unclean, does not make himself clean in this way, will be cut off from the meeting of the people, because he has made the holy place of the Lord unclean: the water has not been put on him, he is unclean.

verses.en: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
verses.pt: Isto lhes será por estatuto perpétuo: o que espargir a água de purificação lavará as suas vestes; e o que tocar a água de purificação será imundo até a tarde.
verses.en_web: It shall be a perpetual statute to them. He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.
verses.en_bbe: This is to be a law for them for ever: he who puts the water on the unclean person is to have his clothing washed; and anyone touching the water will be unclean till evening.

verses.en: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.
verses.pt: E tudo quanto o imundo tocar também será imundo; e a pessoa que tocar naquilo será imunda até a tarde.
verses.en_web: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”
verses.en_bbe: Anything touched by the unclean person will be unclean; and any person touching it will be unclean till evening.
